vscode.guidance: Current VS Code documents Agent Plugins support. 1.110 introduced experimental plugins, not a verified canonical 1.0 minimum. Confirm support in this installed client.
vscode.install: Register only .drydock/mcp-plugins/vscode (drydock-workspace-vscode) using VS Code's documented chat.pluginLocations setting, then enable/review it in the Plugins UI. Do not register the parent folder or another client's variant, and do not auto-approve trust.

cli.guidance: CLI 1.0.74 added Open Plugin Spec v1 manifests/mcp.json. A minimum for all current canonical Agent Plugins 1.0 semantics is not published; confirm support in the installed client.
cli.install: After separate installation/download/trust approval: copilot plugin install ./.drydock/mcp-plugins/cli . Activate only drydock-workspace-cli in this client. Reinstall this variant after regeneration; the client caches installed content. CLI/app may share installed plugins, so do not activate both variants in the same session.

app.guidance: Current Copilot app documentation supports portable plugins; no numeric minimum version is published. Confirm canonical Agent Plugins 1.0 support in this installed client.
app.install: Install the app variant with copilot plugin install ./.drydock/mcp-plugins/app, then inspect Customize > MCP > Installed in the app. Activate only drydock-workspace-app for this app session; CLI/app may share installed plugins, so do not activate both variants in the same session. App-native plugin installation uses Customize > Plugins and a configured marketplace, not an invented local-folder picker. Confirm loaded tools in the active app session.

prerequisites.name: Node.js 20.12+ (use a supported LTS)
prerequisites.action: Install a supported Node LTS and npm/npx yourself. Then approve/cache @azure/mcp@2.0.5 explicitly; see docs/MCP.md.

prerequisites.name: Node.js 20.12+ for Drydock (Playwright MCP itself requires 18+)
prerequisites.action: Install a supported Node LTS/npm and a supported browser. Review the upstream dependency caveat and explicitly cache @playwright/mcp@0.0.80; see docs/MCP.md.

playwright.dependencyCaveat: This non-prerelease MCP package pins playwright and playwright-core to 1.63.0-alpha-2026-08-31. The entire dependency tree is not stable. Review before installing.
